# Stonetop

> Stonetop is a hearth fantasy tabletop roleplaying game (RPG) by Jeremy Strandberg, Powered by the Apocalypse, in which 3-5 people play the heroes of one small, isolated village in an iron age that never was. This site is a free, complete web edition of the game's two rulebooks: every move, playbook, monster, danger, place and arcanum, in English and twenty other languages.

- The books' text is by Jeremy Strandberg and is released under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) — quote it freely, with attribution, under the same licence.
- The artwork is © Lucie Arnoux and is NOT published here: no page carries an illustration, and the Maps page is a text stub listing what the book's two map spreads label.
- Every page is static HTML and needs no JavaScript to read. Stat blocks, moves and tables are ordinary markup.
- A translation is the same slug under a language directory: /de/marshedge.html, /ja/marshedge.html. Slugs and section ids stay English in every language.
- Any page accepts ?q=<terms> and opens with the site search run over the full text of all pages.
- Book I holds the rules; Book II is the setting guide. A page's printed page range is given in its structured data (JSON-LD) as `pagination`.
- Languages published: en, cs, da, de, es, fi, fr, hu, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt-BR, ru, sv, tr, uk, zh-Hans, zh-Hant.

## Minor Arcana

One page per card, numbered as the printed minor arcana cards are.

- [1. Laoj Daveth's Galvanic Infusion](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-laoj-daveths-galvanic-infusion.html): Inside is a tattered letter and a pair of small, bluish ingots. It's a letter, in an older Hillfolk dialect, from an apprentice to their master. It describes a mental exercise to draw latent power…
- [2. Truth Seeds](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-truth-seeds.html): There's this old tale, about an old herb tender from Marshedge that tricks a fen-troll into eating an enchanted seedpod. She promises to go get the troll more food if he promises to then let her go…
- [3. Old Mother's Wine](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-old-mothers-wine.html): A small manual written on what appears to be sheets of supple leaves. It is written in the common script but in a strangely poetic sequence of nonsense syllables.
- [4. Aalz Galt's Sudden Sinkhole](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-aalz-galts-sudden-sinkhole.html): In a ruin of the Stone Lords is an old dwelling that bears the psychic imprint of its inhabitant, a stoneshaper of some considerable skill.
- [5. Shell Game of Souls](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-shell-game-of-souls.html): A moldering skeleton slumps against one wall, showing signs of having been hanged. Yet carved into the cave walls are runes, caked over with mineral deposits.
- [6. Thunderous Bellow](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-thunderous-bellow.html): A bronze plate poking out of the soil, somewhere in the Flats or near the Dread River. It's dented, a bit warped, with Maker-runes and esoteric diagrams etched into the surface. How the heck did it…
- [7. The Fiery Veil](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-fiery-veil.html): In a ruined citadel of the Forge Lords, the grand hall lies empty. The throne is melted slag. The ceiling is shattered. The pillars are scorched and cracked. But intact around the outside of the…
- [8. The Tomb-bog's Mark](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-tomb-bogs-mark.html): Not far from Marshedge, a ways into Ferrier's Fen, lies a peat mound where no birds nest and flowers will not bloom. Since the town's founding, the people of Marshedge have buried certain criminals…
- [9. Fear of the Flame](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-fear-of-the-flame.html): About 4 feet by 7 feet unfurled, woven with stylized patterns of fire and flame. Flickering Maker-runes can be seen in the weaving, always out of focus but hinting at power.
- [10. Mantle Wraiths](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-mantle-wraiths.html): Found on a skeleton that has been stripped clean of flesh and that bears what can only be described as bite marks all along its bones. Close inspection of the mantle reveals sigils woven in silvery…
- [11. Shattering Words of Aalz Childric](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-shattering-words-of-aalz-childric.html): Deep under a giant, ruined fort is a vaulted chamber, once a storeroom but looted long, long ago. A giant skeleton lies just inside, face-down, its skull and ribs staved in.
- [12. Ffyrnig Tonic](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-ffyrnig-tonic.html): Half-buried and largely overgrown, about 4 feet across and weighing hundreds of pounds.
- [13. Song of the Dool Trees](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-song-of-the-dool-trees.html): A scroll, written in a cramped hand and seemingly nonsensical script, with a series of graph-like diagrams. It is accompanied by a flute of bone (from a human arm?). The notes reveal themselves to…
- [14. Ward of Still Waters](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-ward-of-still-waters.html): High in the hills, a stream of snowmelt fills a deep pool in the rocks before flowing on. At the bottom of the pool is a large deposit of lodestone. Rusted old blades (many sized for giants) can be…
- [15. Ice Weaving](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-ice-weaving.html): A book, about 2 feet by 3 feet, just over 6 inches tall when closed. The cover is made of silvery cedarwood planks. The sheets are made of fine vellum, stretched from the hides of some enormous beast.
- [16. The Six Locks of Sajua](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-six-locks-of-sajua.html): A chain, six links long, each link hung with a corroded bronze padlock. 1d4+1 locks bear a stylized face, frozen in a rusty grimace. The keys to these locks are lost to the ages.
- [17. Helior's Shining Ring](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-heliors-shining-ring.html): This simple, golden band catches the light and shines, even in darkness. Its very presence fills goodly people with peace and hope, and servants of darkness with jealous hate.
- [18. Nerth Serpent's Vigor](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-nerth-serpents-vigor.html): Deep in the Great Wood sits a stone, carved with the crude pictograms of the Forest Folk, showing a trail fraught with trials and leading to great power.
- [19. Goldleaf Cloak](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-goldleaf-cloak.html): About 6 feet long, waxy and rigid, shimmering with golden iridescence. Is this truly a leaf from the Golden Oak?
- [20. Opening the Way](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-opening-the-way.html): A letter on faded, pocked papyrus, written in an archaic form of Southern. It invites "Boas" to visit by way of "your nearest portal," with instructions and a circle of arcane sigils. "Ask for…
- [21. The Drowning Scale](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-drowning-scale.html): A strange charm on a simple leather cord, like a scale of some shimmering material. It's cold and clammy to the touch. When you first put it on, everyone nearby shivers from cold. Soon thereafter…
- [22. Preserving Runes](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-preserving-runes.html): High in the hills or mountains, a pair of massive stone doors are set into the hillside. The markings outside are faded and covered in lichen. The doors aren't locked; one lies a bit ajar. Inside…
- [23. Peacebond](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-peacebond.html): High in the hills or mountains, one can find a bricked-over cave mouth. Inside lie dozens of corpses, preserved for centuries by the cold.
- [24. The Eye, Opened](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-eye-opened.html): Secreted away in some Makers' trove is a gleaming white thing, like a key, I guess, but not a specific key, more like the idea of keyness. Hurts to look right at it; makes you aware of your own…
- [25. Sanctifying Mark](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-sanctifying-mark.html): On a rare dry spot in Ferrier's Fen, besieged by foulness, is an ancient arch that still—improbably—stands. Lichen and moss grow thick and healthy, but the keystone remains clear, engraved with a…
- [26. The Green Lord's Shade](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-green-lords-shade.html): A skull, the size of a horse's head but clearly not a horse—nor a drake, nor a wolf, nor a bear. For none of those beasts would bear such mighty antlers as those affixed to this skull.
- [27. Chimeric Transmogrification](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-chimeric-transmogrification.html): Stretched taut on a wooden frame, this old vellum is filled with the intricate and looping glyphs of the Green Lords. Drawings show creatures changing to have traits of other beasts. It seems to be…
- [28. The Sylvan Web](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-sylvan-web.html): In the Great Wood, one can find a copse of many different types of tree, the light dim beneath their canopy and the ground knobbly with interwoven roots. At the center: a patch of thick, multi-hued…
- [29. Flying Cloak](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-flying-cloak.html): An exquisitly fine wool, dyed a pale blue-gray and embroidered with stylized clouds. The edge boasts blue-white runes stitched with aetherium wire. It feels damp, smells of rain and ozone, and…
- [30. Satchel of Plenty](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-satchel-of-plenty.html): Made of thick, stiff leather and decorated with impossibly fine beadwork. The pattern shows a fruit-laden tree sheltering various game and produce and grains. The specifics often change when you…
- [31. Dancing Wind Spirit](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-dancing-wind-spirit.html): A long, thick flute carved of redwood, with a thin but visible crack along the underside. It easily catches the wind and makes a piping sound.
- [32. Call of the Hunt](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-call-of-the-hunt.html): It must have been a majestic beast, finely preserved with pale stones for eyes and a clip to wear it like a hooded cape. But no matter how you scrub, the red stains never come off its teeth.
- [33. Convocation of the Soil](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-convocation-of-the-soil.html): A big old chunk of stone, maybe 5 feet across, covered in mud and algae. There are Maker-runes on it, barely visible. Runes for the earth, and spirits, and rejuvenation.
- [34. Unliving Chimera](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-unliving-chimera.html): Big enough for a grown man to crawl inside, pitted and scratched, engraved with whorly rune-like patterns. The whole thing is caked with rust. At least, you hope that's rust.
- [35. Impudent Polymorph](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-impudent-polymorph.html): 30 inches tall and carved of yew, with a lid shaped like a horned lion and sealed with wax.
- [36. Make Pliant the Stone](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-make-pliant-the-stone.html): A cylinder about 4 feet long and 3 inches wide, the glass surprisingly thin. It rings with a rich, sonorous chime when struck softly. When struck firmly, the sound is almost deafening and causes a…
- [37. Plaster of Joining](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-plaster-of-joining.html): A jar of fine pottery, the size of a small cookpot.
- [38. Cold Mind, Iron Body](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-cold-mind-iron-body.html): A cord almost 10 feet long, strung with bronze beads. Each bead is carved with a different glyph and a figure in a unique meditative pose.
- [39. Little Friend](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-little-friend.html): Inside a case of carved ivory rests a scroll made of fine, almost gauzy wool. It is full of glyphs and diagrams, imprinted with rich dyes of red and black and yellow. The diagrams seem to depict…
- [40. Revealing Light](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-revealing-light.html): An oversized, highly decorated lamp, shaped like a chalice with a wide cup, like those lamps they use up north to burn mammoth-butter in their rituals.
- [41. Darkwalker Cloak](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-darkwalker-cloak.html): The hide of some unknown, black-furred beast. Its bristles are stiff and the air nearby is always chill.
- [42. The Flesh Is Like Clay](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-flesh-is-like-clay.html): There's a cave somewhere—somewhere that the light never shines—where the walls are roiling formations, slick and wet, glinting with veins of red crystal that no longer glows. The stone undulates in…
- [43. Fetch's Mask](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-fetchs-mask.html): ◇ if stowed; magical This stiff, leathery mask looks a bit like melted wax. A large pearlescent sphere is embedded in the forehead. It seems to whisper as you move to put it on.
- [44. Witch Bottle](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-witch-bottle.html): About 10 inches tall, tapered at the top, made of old warped glass that's shot through with silvery streaks, like the trails that slugs leave. The patterns in the glass seem different each time you…
- [45. Wishing Candles](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-wishing-candles.html): A remarkably supple scroll, given its age, found in an ivory tube. It bears writing in a strange alphabet, penned in a dark red ink. There are diagrams, too. You think it might be some sort of…
- [46. Baleful Utterance](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-baleful-utterance.html): Hidden from the sun, in a ring of runes, there is a... word?... floating in the air. Squiggling and wriggling, yearning to be free, it whispers promises of power. But the runes around it fill you…
- [47. Aetherium Spear](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-aetherium-spear.html): Hidden away in some vault or cave or Maker-ruin is a length of copper, heavily corroded and coated with chunks of verdigris. If you squint, you vaguely make out the shape of a spearhead.
- [48. Staff of Magnetism](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-staff-of-magnetism.html): A short staff, about 4 feet tall, tapering towards the tip and made of blackened oak with a strange metallic sheen. A dozen bands adorn it, made of corroded copper, caked in verdigris and crumbling…
- [49. Groundskimmer](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-groundskimmer.html): It's like two of those canoes they use in Marshedge, but bigger and with big fins at the back.
- [50. Thunderbolt Bow](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-thunderbolt-bow.html): A short flatbow made of pale blue metal, rigid and gracefully curved even though it's unstrung.
- [51. Bronze Protector](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-bronze-protector.html): A bronze statue, but not really a statue, more like bits of armor cleverly joined around a skeleton of interlocking pipes. And the "chest" is less a breastplate than a little potbelly stove…
- [52. Sublime Words](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-sublime-words.html): "An Ustrina once offered me a mirror, a flawless thing framed in gold. It showed me, but… a better me, you see? They said who made it, one of the Forge Lords, I think? Said she 'poured her Sublime…
- [53. Flaming Sword](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-flaming-sword.html): It was clearly once a fine, fine blade. The steel holds a pattern of rune-like sworls, at least where the rust hasn't taken over. The hilt is blackened, with hints of leather wrappings that long ago…
- [54. Searing Touch](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-searing-touch.html): Found in the workshop of some Forge Lord, still held in a vice-clamp. The head is a runic shape,
- [55. Sigil of Authority](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-sigil-of-authority.html): A ring of white metal, untarnished and gleaming, a single glyph carved into the bezel. The symbol squirms under your gaze, like it exists in more dimensions than you can perceive. The ring fits you…
- [56. Horn of Storms](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-horn-of-storms.html): You got it off a stranger. Like, maybe on a bet, or in a contest, or as a gift in return for some kindness. Or maybe you took it without his consent? Regardless, he seemed a bit coy about the horn…
- [57. Moonstone](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-moonstone.html): Found in a cave, a mountain, or some rocky outcrop, likely considered sacred by the locals. It looks like cloudy white quartz, but glows faintly at night.
- [58. Hand of Aals Sannan](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-hand-of-aals-sannan.html): Found in an engraved lead box, this grisly relic is adorned with three golden rings (Value 2).
- [59. Bittersweet Elixir](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-bittersweet-elixir.html): A wide, shallow bowl carved with flowers and thorny vines, twining through skulls of deer and other beasts. The pattern shifts when you aren't looking; it's never exactly the same twice.
- [60. The Broom's Lullaby](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-brooms-lullaby.html): Just a well-worn stick of rowan wood, in need of some new bristles. You wouldn't give it another thought. Except... when you hold it, and sweep with it, you find yourself humming a half-remembered…
- [61. The Angry Little God](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-angry-little-god.html): Found at the back of some cave or grotto, obscured by roots and rubble, surrounded by desiccated, rotting offerings. A crude squat thing with a possum's sneering face, a thorny tail, and flowers for…
- [62. The Silver Branch](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-the-silver-branch.html): A tattered scrap of parchment. It shows a path from a particular set of standing stones: through a marsh, up a river, to a place behind a waterfall, then through a forest of sword-sharp trees.
- [63. Void Elemental](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-void-elemental.html): A circlet of black, glossy metal set with eight spires of aetherium. It's sized for a head maybe twice as large as yours, and is always a bit chill to the touch. Even cast into the hottest furnace…
- [64. Runes of Creation](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/minor-runes-of-creation.html): A 6" cube of dull gray metal, covered in hinges, knobs, dials, sliders, levers, and the like. A thing of mad genius, resisting all attempts to open it by brute force.

## Major Arcana

One page per card, numbered as the printed major arcana cards are.

- [1. Staff of the Lidless Orb](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-staff-of-the-lidless-orb.html): A sphere of greenish glass, etched with a cat's-eye design and set atop a staff of rough, pitted black iron. The orb catches the light and seems to glow, and the pupil seems to widen in the dark and…
- [2. Twisted Spear](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-twisted-spear.html): A knobby length of wood, pale as death and hard as steel, tapering to a needle point. The shaft is scored and notched, the tip stained with blood and soot.
- [3. Demonhide Cloak](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-demonhide-cloak.html): A tattered cloak, stitched from a motley patchwork of unfamiliar hides and leather. Shifting odors waft from it: damp earth, ozone, musk, sulfur, rust, rot.
- [4. Noruba's Ice Sphere](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-norubas-ice-sphere.html): A perfect sphere of dark ice, the size of a fist, never melting, hard as stone, and set like a gaudy gem at the end of a finely wrought torc. Or not a torc, perhaps, but maybe a ring that once sat…
- [5. Mindgem](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-mindgem.html): A chunk of makerglass the size of a human head; inspection reveals facets within facets, a thousandfold.
- [6. Whispering Rocks](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-whispering-rocks.html): Jagged hunks of black volcanic glass. Surely the swirling movement in their depths is a trick of light.
- [7. Blood-quenched Sword](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-blood-quenched-sword.html): An ancient blade of deep red bronze, its pommel etched with symbols like those that the Hillfolk use to decorate their drinking horns. It thrums in its scabbard, wanting nothing more than to be…
- [8. Shield of the Wisent Witch](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-shield-of-the-wisent-witch.html): A shield of horn-oak, glossy from long use, shod in bronze and adorned with a stylized wisent skull.
- [9. Hec'tumel Codex](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-hectumel-codex.html): A dozen copper plates, green with age and bound with loops of reddish metal wire. The outer plates are embossed with strange images of man and beast while the inner plates are etched with arcane…
- [10. Red Scepter](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-red-scepter.html): A bronze rod, tipped with a glowing red crystal and carved with openwork shapes of hungry, leering faces.
- [11. Ring of Daagon](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-ring-of-daagon.html): A finely carved ring of copper, coated in verdigris and always a little damp. Its shape is that of a strange, reptilian creature devouring its own tail.
- [12. Rune-laden Scales](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-rune-laden-scales.html): An ancient vest of bluish steel, each scale etched with a silvery rune similar to those found among the ruins near Barrier Pass. A working of the Makers, no doubt, or at least of their most gifted…
- [13. Blackwood Fetishes](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-blackwood-fetishes.html): A pair of wooden figurines, carved from blackwood and worn smooth with age and use. A whitish shaft has been driven into the top of each figurine's head, and the eyes and forehead of each are…
- [14. Storm Markings](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-storm-markings.html): A series of branching, tree-like markings coursing up and down your skin. Usually pale blue, almost like veins, but when you become agitated they seem to glow, pulse, and ripple with light.
- [15. Ineffable Words](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-ineffable-words.html): Syllables of the first language, words of pure thought and will, emblazoned on your soul and tongue by some angelic force or being. A gift, perhaps. Or a terrible, terrible affliction.
- [16. Redwood Effigy](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-redwood-effigy.html): A vaguely man-shaped root of blood-red wood, wrapped in tattered cloth. Bright blue markings adorn the fabric, as do rust-colored stains.
- [17. Hungering Maw of Hlad](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-hungering-maw-of-hlad.html): A ring of black metal bands, woven in an intricate pattern beyond the skills of modern smiths. The way the bands twist on each other seems to defy reality, and the weak-willed find themselves…
- [18. Azure Hand](https://stonetop-wiki.github.io/major-azure-hand.html): A thick staff of gray metal, topped with a plate of aetherium in the shape of a stylized hand. The palm is embossed with a cloud and lightning bolt, and the whole thing is more than a little…
